title: ConfigEntryContribution
description: A single configuration entry parsed from a config artifact (application.yaml, .env, kubernetes manifests, terraform vars, ...). Identity is (path, key). Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (techno-specific KSs, Rule 1): `ConfigKS` today (multi-format parser); future format-specific KSs may post here. The `configFormat` discriminator tags the source vocabulary.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the config file. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

configFormat.description: Pattern-C discriminator (§8bis Rule 2). Source-file format the producer parsed.

key.description: Dotted/slash key path within the file.

value.description: Raw value (any JSON type). Secret-detection / redaction is client-side.

secretSuspected.description: Client-side heuristic flag; the value MAY be redacted when true.

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Format-specific fields (e.g. YAML anchors, HCL block-type, JSON-pointer flavour, `.env` quoting style).
